depiction.primary_object: empty hourglass outline with flat top and bottom bars
modifiers: circular badge at bottom right containing two vertical pause bars
depiction.composition: single object, front view, with bottom-right badge overlay

readings.meaning: subscription, account, or service on hold
postponed deadline or frozen waiting period
break or timeout during timed work

ambiguity: At small sizes the two vertical bars in the badge can look like a power plug outlet or the Roman numeral II.

modifier_semantics.modifier: circular badge with two vertical pause bars
modifier_semantics.meaning: paused, on hold, suspended, or temporarily stopped

task_intents: put a subscription or membership on hold
freeze a recurring billing cycle temporarily
pause an automated countdown or job
request an extension or freeze on a deadline
defer a waiting period or trial

reasoning: The icon depicts an hourglass with a pause badge in the bottom-right corner, clearly communicating paused time, a suspended countdown, or putting something on hold. It fits tasks about freezing subscriptions, holding memberships, or pausing timers and SLAs, though it must be distinguished from a plain hourglass (waiting/timers) or a cancellation slash.
